items: Amazon mapped its own delivery to 95% of ZIP codes. Business Insider reported on 'Project Aurelian,' a contingency plan to cover about 39,400 ZIP codes and 99.9% of demand by 2029 if the USPS deal fell through.

UPS and FedEx now sell verified-handoff delivery. UPS Protected Delivery requires a recipient PIN ($10.70 a package, per the AJC); FedEx Authenticated Delivery requires a QR code ($20 a package on select express services).

DoorDash launched $7.99 courier returns. Dashers pick up returns with no box or label and take them back to the store; Macy's, Anthropologie and VF brands also joined, and DoorDash is flying drones it designed itself.
